name: joblookup-bridge
description: Lets the local JobLookup app use your GitHub Copilot seat through VS Code's Language Model API.

joblookupBridge.port.description: Preferred port (127.0.0.1 only). If it is taken by something other than the bridge, a free port is used automatically. Use 0 to always pick a free one.

joblookupBridge.modelFamily.description: Preferred Copilot model family, e.g. gpt-4o-mini or claude-haiku-4.5. Leave empty and the bridge picks a fast, inexpensive model it can see.

joblookupBridge.autoStart.description: Start the bridge automatically when VS Code opens.
